statement: For every integer n>=1, every partition of [n] into nonempty blocks B_v, and every rooted tree tau on those blocks, let D_v be the union of descendant blocks including B_v and N_v=|D_v|. Set Q_tau={x in R^n: x_i>=0 for all i and sum_{i in D_v} x_i<=N_v for every v}. Let W_tau be all length-n words over [n] with at least N_v occurrences of letters from D_v for every v, and des(w)=|{j:1<=j<n, w_j>w_{j+1}}|. With sum_{m>=0}|m Q_tau intersect Z^n| t^m=h*(Q_tau,t)/(1-t)^(n+1), one has h*(Q_tau,t)=sum_{w in W_tau} t^(n-1-des(w)). Equivalently, for every integer m>=0, |m Q_tau intersect Z^n|=sum_{a in A_tau} product_{i=1}^n binom(m+1,a_i), where A_tau={a in Z_{≥0}^n:sum_i a_i=n and sum_{i in D_v} a_i>=N_v for every v}, and binom(m+1,a_i)=0 when a_i>m+1. No restriction on block labels, sizes, depth, or branching is imposed.
contribution: Proposed complete proof of Athanasiadis-Xiao-Yan, arXiv:2603.11654v1, Conjecture 5.2, using a polynomial transformation that intertwines upper and lower subtree truncations. The height-counting recurrence, binomial-content reformulation, and multiset-word identity are credited as known; the new proposed step is their compatible subtree transformation and all-arbor consequence. No equivalent proof was found in the bounded primary-source comparison of 2026-09-14. The broader conjecture for arbitrary preorders is outside the claimed scope. Fresh mathematical review is requested; no acceptance is asserted.
